speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what procedures and safeguards are being put in place before Temporary Occupation Licences are granted over sea spaces; and (b) what is the long-term plan for the governance and planning of sea spaces by URA.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: During the Adjournment Motion on protecting our marine spaces and Southern Islands earlier this year, the Minister for National Development also shared how agencies coordinate our plans from planning to implementation and engage nature groups and other stakeholders, so that their inputs can be considered.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: URA, MPA and the relevant agencies will continue to engage the community on plans for our sea spaces.

speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
text: Ms Nadia Samdin, I will allow a supplementary question, but please make it brief.

speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I understand that environmental impact assessments (EIAs) will only be conducted if the technical agencies consider that the impact may be significant.

speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Could the Senior Minister of State please elaborate on what is the threshold of impact or some of the criteria that are considered significant?

speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
text: And what is the required frequency of ongoing environmental monitoring which is in place for such sea spaces?

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: For example, the EPE, from when we last completed it, had given us inputs for the Long-Term Plan Review.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: Those assessments will guide the agencies in the use of sea space.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: Earlier in the session, we had a discussion on the use of sea spaces for aquaculture and fish farming where Senior Minister of State Koh Poh Koon had given answers to Ms Nadia Samdin and Mr Louis Ng.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: So, this is a real-life example of how we use the EPE and how the agencies use the EPE to guide some of the environmental impact assessments for the use of those spaces.

speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
text: So, it will be case-by-case, for the specific use.

speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Notice of Motion.

speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), provided that Members had not asked for questions standing in their names to be postponed to a later Sitting day or withdrawn, written answers to questions not reached by the end of Question Time are reproduced in the Appendix.]
